source_material.description: KESPA Jira/project update dated 2026-09-22 covering private artifact architecture, live upload debugging, storage hygiene, plan guardrails, security boundaries, and open QA items.
KESPA current-state README addendum dated 2026-09-22 covering artifact scope, storage model, retrieval design, processing options, and operational status.
KESPA future-plan document dated 2026-09-22 used only to identify explicitly future artifact-intelligence work and avoid presenting planned features as completed results.
Current KESPA public research manifest with schema kespa.public_research_index.v1, 37 existing entries, and KESPA-NOTE-024 as the latest technical-note ID before this package.

directly_recorded_facts: KESPA has a private artifact architecture for uploaded files and images.
Artifacts can be scoped to chat, project, or account.
The private artifact storage root is outside the public web root.
Original artifact blobs are encrypted at rest.
A live artifact was successfully stored after the recorded upload fixes.
The successfully stored artifact was recorded as owned by the PHP service account and permissioned 600.
The implementation explicitly names user_artifacts, user_artifact_chunks, user_artifact_terms, and message_artifacts.
PHP-FPM private-storage write access was one recorded upload failure and was corrected.
Numeric search-term type conversion was a second recorded upload failure and was corrected by casting terms to string before hashing.
Runtime storage is ignored by Git and the recorded git ls-files storage check returned no tracked storage content.
Semantic cross-chat artifact recall and the artifact-enrichment cron remain items requiring deliberate production verification.

derived_values.name: upload_failures_resolved
derived_values.formula: count(the two independently enumerated live upload failures)

interpretations: The artifact system establishes a distinct private-evidence boundary rather than treating uploaded files as ordinary global memory.
The current evidence supports verification of encrypted storage and scope foundations but not a verified claim of semantic cross-chat retrieval quality or multimodal enrichment.

recorded_complete_or_live_verified: successful live artifact persistence after fixes
permission mode 600 on the recorded stored artifact
not_yet_verified_end_to_end: artifact enrichment worker under production cron
